text:
ashok: FYI folks — Customer Accerella reporting spike in P99 tail for embeddings on Dedicated. SLA risk if we don't land a short-term mitigation by EOD. pinging owners.
maria: saw the alert. looks like KV cache misses spiking on pool-b3, correlates with new canary.
devon: confirming — canary v2.3 changed kv-prefetch behavior, PR #4829 landed yesterday. I can revert or hotfix.
kira: infra note — pool-b3 is on older driver, might exacerbate misses. upgrading driver requires node restart (30m window).
ash: @devon if revert helpful, what's rollout timeline?
devon: revert + restart rollout ~45m with canary gating. quick plan: revert PR, promote v2.2 canary, monitor p99.
maria: alternative short-term: enable prefix-kv-cache for Accerella project only. config is runtime flag: `ENABLE_PREFIX_KV_CACHE=true` on service. no restart.
ash: that sounds lower risk. who can flip and run smoke?
kira: I can flip on the service-config for Accerella route. need exact svc name and run a canary toggle command.
jules: svc is `redwood-embedder-acc` in prod-dedicated-b3. devon can you confirm the config will behave with v2.3?
devon: yes, should be safe. it forces local prefix caching and bypasses new prefetch path. I will monitor logs for errors.
ash: ok assign owners: devon = code/monitoring, kira = config flip, maria = rollout validation and metrics. ETA target 40m.
prod-bot: Incident created — INC-2026-045: Accerella dedicated p99 spike. Priority: P1.
product-liaison: I'll update the CS thread and ask Accerella to expect a short change window. will mention no downtime expected.
maria: quick check list for validation: 1) p99 across region < target 300ms, 2) errors <= baseline, 3) token cost stable.
devon: pushing revert PR now: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/4831
```
git checkout -b revert/kv-prefetch
git revert 4829
```
kira: prepping config toggle command: `redctl svc config set redwood-embedder-acc ENABLE_PREFIX_KV_CACHE=true --env=prod-dedicated-b3`
ash: after flip, maria will run: `promql p99(embed_latency{customer="accerella"})` and post results here.
maria: will do. will also run a small synthetic load with `tools/loadgen -c accerella -q 50` to validate 1m after change.
jules: if revert goes well, let's keep v2.2 on pool-b3 until driver upgrade is scheduled. we should open a follow-up to plan driver upgrade and test matrix.
product-liaison: Accerella wants ETA for full fix — can we commit to driver upgrade slot next week?
kira: I can schedule a node maintenance window Wed 02:00-04:00 UTC. needs cross-check with infra calendar.
devon: ok for me. for now doing revert+toggle. I'll post statuses here.
ash: thanks team. quick status cadence: update in 15m with first smoke results, then on completion. tag @oncall if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
